# go-modern-strings-cut

**Since:** Go 1.18

## Summary

Use strings.Cut instead of strings.Index plus manual slicing.

## Details

strings.Cut returns before, after, and found in one call.
It makes split-at-first-separator logic explicit and removes manual Index checks and slicing.

## Examples

### Before

```go
i := strings.Index(s, ":")
if i < 0 {
  return "", "", false
}
key, value := s[:i], s[i+1:]
```

### After

```go
key, value, found := strings.Cut(s, ":")
```
